formalDefinition: Bernstein Vazirani = {(n, <w_1, w_2, ... , w_(2^n - 1), w_(2^n)> | n is int, w_i is bit (0 or 1)}
problemDefinition: The Bernstein-Vazirani problem asks for the identification of an unknown bit string s that defines a linear Boolean function f(x)= s*x (mod 2). The task is to determine the hidden string s using as few queries as possible
inputDescription: f, a boolean oracle function of the form f(x) = s * x (mod 2) for some hidden bit string s
outputDescription: s, the hidden bit string encoded by f
source: Bernstein, Ethan, and Umesh, Vazirani. Quantum complexity theory. Proceedings of the twenty-fifth annual ACM symposium on Theory of computing. 1993.

defaultSolver.solverDefinition: This is a classical verifier for the Bernstein-Vazirani problem which runs in O(n) time.

defaultVerifier.verifierDefinition: Verify that a proposed solution bit string fulfills the promise of the Bernstein-Vazirani problem: f(x) = s · x for all x.

defaultVisualization.visualizationDefinition: Requests QASM for the Bernstein-Vazirani circuit (Hadamards, oracle, measure data qubits) to show how one query recovers the hidden bit string for Q.js rendering.

solver.solverDefinition: This is a classical verifier for the Bernstein-Vazirani problem which runs in O(n) time.
